verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette (cmd+j) lets users type any natural-language instruction against highlighted text and save it as a custom prompt, and users can 'chat' with filtered notes to ask questions. The evidence does not show natural language driving the app itself, such as creating, moving, tagging or linking notes. Missing for 10: natural-language control of app actions and navigation, an agentic command mode beyond text transformation and Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
